messages:
maya: Quick sync — I want to collapse a few overlapping initiatives into a single long-term routing/tenancy roadmap for the product review. Primary asks: clear canary criteria, tenancy lanes (latency vs cost tiers), and cross-region fallback behaviour. Can we align owners and launch gates by EOW?

sam: +1. Suggest we define a lightweight policy DSL first (3-4 primitives) so rollout tooling can target predictable behaviors. Proposed gating metrics: p99 tail latency, error-rate delta vs baseline, and tenant QoS violations > threshold.

jana: From customer signals: enterprise customers want residency + SLA bundles, smaller customers want best-effort low-cost lanes. We should map those bundles to tenancy lanes (e.g., Gold: pinned region + SLA, Silver: regional affinity + fallback) and include contractual cutoffs.

rolf: Ops constraints — we need tracing + per-tenant telemetry before any pinned-region canary. Also automated eviction playbook: if eviction rate > 0.5% across 5m, autoscale and degrade to fallback model. Otherwise we'll get paging at 2am. :grimacing:

ben: For prioritization I'd like a simple matrix: customer impact x implementation effort x risk of SLA regression. Can we sketch that in a doc and tag examples (Customer A wants pinned region, Customer B wants low cost)?

maya: Agreed. Next steps: Sam to draft DSL + sample policy snippet, Rolf to list observability requirements, Jana to collect 3 customer archetypes, Ben to own prioritization matrix. I'll own the launch-criteria doc and coordinating the product review.

sam: Draft policy sketch (WIP):
```
policy {
  tenancy_lane: "gold" // pinned-region, reserved capacity
  fallback: ["regional-affinity", "shared-host"]
  sla: { p99_ms: 250, availability: 99.9 }
}
```
Will expand to cover rollout phases: feature-flagged canary -> A/B -> full cutover.

rolf: I'll add required telemetry signals (per-tenant p50/p95/p99, eviction-count, KV-cache-hit-rate) and a quick checklist for automation runbooks.

jana: I'll add customer examples to the doc and short quotes we can use in the roadmap deck.

maya: Good. Can someone create a single doc + one tracking PR? If the bot can scaffold a doc we can iterate. @taylor can you help with the deck frame? :eyes:

deploy-bot: created doc https://redwood.internal/docs/routing-tenancy-roadmap-draft and branch routing/roadmap-1724536789

taylor: Happy to do the deck frame — will slot a 2-slide TL;DR and a 1-slide gating matrix. Meeting to review tomorrow 11am?

maya: 11am works. Thanks everyone — please add initial notes to the doc before EOD so I can synthesize for product review.
